svg.title: Most tests need no network. Capacity is at the knee.
svg.desc: A test pyramid with a wide base of unit tests at about 1 ms each, a middle band of TestClient endpoint tests at about 50 ms each, and a narrow top of contract and smoke tests against a deployment. Beside it, a plot of offered concurrency against throughput and p99 latency: throughput rises then flattens while p99 climbs steeply, and the crossing point is ringed and labelled THE KNEE. The average-latency curve is crossed out as useless. Below, /healthz and /readyz are separated, with one shared handler crossed out.
svg.text: Most tests need no network. Capacity is at the knee.
where the tests should actually be
5 endpoint tests, 0.25 s in total - measured. A
suite that needs a database to start is a suite
a slow database then restarts every pod you have
the average hides the knee. Always read p95/p99.
async at c=200: 2 565 rps, p50 59 ms · sync def: 655 rps, p50 279 ms ·
